name: Stupice
notes: Developed in cold/cloudy Czech climate. One of the most fog-resilient varieties known. Priority candidate.

name: Glacier
notes: Sets fruit in cold temps. Breeders specifically targeted cool-summer climates.

name: Siletz
notes: Bred for Pacific Northwest fog. Sets fruit even when nights are cold.

name: Legend
notes: Late blight resistant. Handles damp/fog well. DTM slightly longer — monitor closely.

name: Sungold
notes: Cherry size reduces heat per fruit. Sweet flavor even under partial cloud cover.

name: Early Girl
notes: Bay Area standard. Earlier than most, familiar with coastal conditions.

name: Juliet
notes: Crack-resistant plum. Sets fruit in cool conditions but may not ripen well in deep fog.

name: Black Krim
notes: Handles cool nights from Russian origin. Long DTM is a liability for Sausalito's short warm window.

name: San Marzano
notes: Paste varieties need heat and dry conditions. Fog and humidity are structural enemies.

name: Brandywine
notes: Legendary flavor but heat-hungry. Fog belt almost certain to frustrate it.

name: Cherokee Purple
notes: Prefers long hot summers. May produce marginally but not to potential.

name: TBD
notes: Confirm 12th variety with friend. Update all fields once known.
